# Lucky Store

> Online grocery and daily bazaar delivery from Lucky Store in Chawkbazar, Chattogram.

Lucky Store is a neighborhood grocery store serving Chattogram families since 1947. The storefront lets customers browse groceries, pantry staples, tea, snacks, household essentials, and personal care items, then order for local doorstep delivery within the verified 1 km Chawkbazar delivery area. Orders support Cash on Delivery and bKash after doorstep inspection.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.luckystore1947.com): Featured groceries, popular categories, delivery confidence notes, and current product sections.
- [All categories](https://www.luckystore1947.com/category): Browse the full public product catalog.
- [Delivery information](https://www.luckystore1947.com/delivery): Delivery radius, fees, hours, Cash on Delivery, bKash, and doorstep inspection policy.
- [Contact](https://www.luckystore1947.com/contact): Store address, phone, email, WhatsApp, map, and customer support form.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.luckystore1947.com/privacy): Customer data handling and privacy terms.
- [Terms of service](https://www.luckystore1947.com/terms): Storefront ordering and service terms.
